tex_content.source:
\label{sec:wave-spherical-means}

For $x\in\R^n$ and $r,t>0$, define the spherical averages
$$(12)\qquad U(x;r,t):=\fint_{\partial B(x,r)}u(y,t)\,dS(y),$$
and similarly
$$(13)\qquad
G(x;r):=\fint_{\partial B(x,r)}g(y)\,dS(y),
\qquad
H(x;r):=\fint_{\partial B(x,r)}h(y)\,dS(y).$$
